findings.degree_totals: The BA requires 120 credits, including 90 arts/sciences and 30 upper-division credits, with a six-credit arts/sciences exception for concurrent BA+BS students and major GPA of 2.000. The engineering AI BS requires 123 credits; separate Arts and Sciences BS rules do not apply.
findings.university: CWRU GPA must be at least 2.000. Complete 60 CWRU credits, including 15 after reaching 105 total credits, and half of major requirements at CWRU, including required related-field work. Matriculation or later catalog selection and review after ten years remain explicit.
findings.breadth: AI belongs to STEM+N. Complete 18 outside-area credits, with six each in arts/humanities and social sciences/management. Preserve the nine-credit test/transfer limit, three CWRU credits per area and approved incoming-transfer exception. One cross-listed course counts in only one breadth area.
findings.communication: Inquiry, two communication-intensive courses, disciplinary communication, capstone and portfolio remain required. Minimum credits, CWRU residency and appeal conditions remain explicit. Variable-credit capstones require three total credits; the MGMT 395 route requires three sections.
findings.wellness: Complete two semester-equivalents, including one with physical movement, independent of credit amounts. Repetition exceptions, formal enrollment, military waiver and transfer conditions remain explicit.
findings.perspectives: Four distinct obligations remain. Local/global engagement can use an approved activity. Transfer substitution requires an FSCUE appeal. A course can meet every approved requirement except duplicate breadth areas.
findings.permissions: Requisite and career restrictions remain binding unless the appropriate permission is granted. Career restrictions require school registrar/administrator action; approval still requires subsequent registration. No automatic waiver or eligibility is inferred.
findings.secondary_major: Full-degree records preserve the school-specific requirement exemption when AI serves only as a secondary major within another undergraduate degree.
findings.substitutions: Unlisted AI-related substitutions require advisor permission; technical electives require chair/designee permission. At most two of four technical electives may come from Group 2, without double counting. Suggested two-course sequences remain recommendations.

remaining_second_pass: The coordinator separately read 207 UGER course descriptions and previously checked the fixed core. This policy review does not assert a second reading of all 744 BA or 756 BS records, complete cross-list reconciliation, or a full-degree second-pass certification.
